tools.name: set_stage
tools.description: Record which stage of the project's pipeline this session is in (shown to the user above the prompt). Call it whenever your work moves between stages: planning (reading, designing, writing a plan), building/implementing (editing code), testing/QA/verifying (running tests, validating, reviewing), and shipping/committing (git commit, push, opening a PR). Pass `stage` as one of the stage ids and a one-line `note` saying what you are about to do. Some stages are gates: moving past an unapproved gate is refused, and you must then ask the user to review and run `/lk approve` before trying again. Never try to work around a gate. Some stages need a verifier (marked ⇄): before moving past one, spawn a verifier subagent (a reviewer, validator or critic with fresh context) to check the work against the plan's Done-when, then try again. At the start of each task call it with stage plan and `size`: small (one clear change in at most 3 files; the plan gate and the verifier are waived and the pipeline goes straight to execute) or large (the full loop). With size large also pass `files`, how many files the plan touches: approving the plan approves a file budget of that many files plus a margin, so the gates do not ask on every turn. Once a plan validator subagent has checked a large plan, record its result with stage validate-plan and `verdict` consistent or issues; consistent opens the plan gate by itself unless the user approves plans.

tools.name: review_cycle
tools.description: Record one pass of a bounded loop (critic pass, code review round, plan validation, test run, copy edit, design review) for a subject (an asset name, a PR, a plan, a file set) and get its loop state back: cycle n/max, history, whether it is done, passes left and open items. Call it right after each pass. "kind" (first pass only, default critic) sets the rules: critic (score, target 9.0, 4 passes), design (score, 9.0, 4), copy (score, 8.5, 3), review (items, 3 rounds), plan (items, 2 passes), qa (items, 3 runs). Score kinds need "score" out of 10 and are done when it reaches the target; item kinds ("score" optional) are done when no p0 or p1 item is open. Leave "cycle" out to use the next number. List the findings in "items"; items carry over between cycles until marked done. kind, target and maxCycles count only on the first pass of a subject; afterwards only the user changes them. A pass past maxCycles is refused: when the reply says "not converging", stop iterating and surface to the user.

tools.name: review_item
tools.description: Add an open item to a review subject, or close one with done: true and a proof (a file path, a command output excerpt, or a commit). Closing without proof is allowed but is shown as "(no proof)". done: false reopens an item.

tools.name: review_status
tools.description: Show the review loop state of one subject, or of every subject in this project when "subject" is left out.

tools.name: record_decision
tools.description: Record a decision in this project's decision log (the file loopkeeper found: a decisions.jsonl, a decisions.md under .claude/brain or a DECISION_JOURNAL.md). Call it once, right after the user and you settle a design or implementation choice worth remembering later: a library or architecture pick, a convention, a trade-off, a rejected alternative. Do not call it for routine edits or for choices still under discussion. Write the decision as one plain sentence, the reason in "why", and a few short lowercase tags. The entry is appended; nothing already in the log is changed.
